verdict.rationale: Twenty's API docs state that both REST and GraphQL support batch create, update and delete of up to 60 records per request, plus batch upsert in GraphQL. Bulk scale is extended by CSV/XLSX import with duplicate detection, unlimited API import, exports of up to 20,000 records, and workflow Iterator steps for looping over many records. Missing for 10: a documented UI-level multi-select bulk edit/delete; evidence that AI agents or the MCP server can run bulk operations; independent or hands-on corroboration; and a way past the 60-record-per-request cap.
